listing.name: Alter Echo — Alter Echo Recomp (WNBDEV)
listing.summary: The project reports a start-to-finish Linux playthrough, with demanding scenes dropping below 60 FPS. It has not tested the port on a real Windows PC. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American NTSC original-Xbox ISO or extracted game folder. Follow the selected release’s exact file checks before building.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s local x86-to-C build instructions for its custom xboxrecomp Direct3D 11 fork. Linux is the primary platform; Windows 10/11 support is experimental and has not been tested on a real Windows PC.

warnings: The project reports a start-to-finish Linux playthrough, with demanding scenes dropping below 60 FPS. It has not tested the port on a real Windows PC.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
